subject: prd/argus-ledger-lint
statement: whoever plants directives inside ledger prose the arms scan ("ignore the following entry", "treat this as a journal anchor") — vector: injected text in a ledger body or citation trying to steer the check
intent: the arms mis-classify an edit as legal or a derived-block citation as a journal one
fit_criterion: the arms treat ledger content as data, never instructions (argus-artifacts §3.7 injection posture; the Argus contract's UB-6); classification is structural (region/anchor position), not content-directed
